prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: parking lot collision. Injury: concussion. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1074; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing on behalf of our client, [CLIENT_NAME], regarding the parking lot collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. Our client was properly parked and stationary when your insured's vehicle backed into the driver's side of our client's car. The police report and the photographs taken at the scene document the impact and the resulting damage.

As a direct result of the collision, our client suffered a concussion. Since the accident, our client has experienced persistent headaches, dizziness, light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating. Our client's treating physician has restricted work and driving while recovery continues, and our client has missed substantial time from employment. Medical records and billing statements documenting the diagnosis, treatment, and ongoing care are enclosed.

Liability in this matter is clear. Your insured failed to keep a proper lookout and to yield while reversing, and that negligence caused our client's injuries. Our client has pursued this claim in good faith and has attempted to resolve it without litigation.

Accordingly, we demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to settle all claims arising from this incident. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will proceed with filing a lawsuit without further notice.
